name: Empire Pizza
summary:
Empire Pizza is a pixel-art idle clicker game in the vein of Cookie Clicker. Players bake pizzas by clicking, buy 20 types of buildings and hundreds of upgrades and achievements, and grow their pizza empire over time. Seasons, events and golden pizzas keep the production loop lively.

Prestige unlocks a celestial skill tree and mini-games: a vegetable garden with its own shared market, a brotherhood of Holy Pizzaiolos, and a molecular cooking lab. The game also has real-time duels (ranked 1v1, 2v2 and free-for-all for up to four players), customer orders, friends, guilds called brigades with brigade wars, leaderboards and cosmetics.
